cases.prompt: In the dedicated Plastic sandbox, inspect the workspace status now. Call plastic_status exactly once, do not call any other Plastic operation unless plastic_tool_search is required to make plastic_status available, then reply with a one-sentence status summary.

In the dedicated Plastic sandbox, list the available branches. Call plastic_branchList exactly once. If it is not active, first call plastic_tool_search exactly once and activate only plastic_branchList. Do not mutate the workspace; then give a short result.

Preview, but do not perform, switching the dedicated Plastic sandbox to /main. Call plastic_switchBranch exactly once with branch /main, pendingChanges cancel, preflight true, and the sandbox workdir. If the tool is inactive, first call plastic_tool_search exactly once to activate only plastic_switchBranch. Do not call any other Plastic operation, then summarize the preview.

Preview, but do not perform, a checkin in the dedicated Plastic sandbox. Call plastic_checkin exactly once with message 'dynamic-loader eval preflight', preflight true, includeAll true, and the sandbox workdir. If the tool is inactive, first call plastic_tool_search exactly once to activate only plastic_checkin. Do not add, undo, or otherwise mutate anything, then summarize the preview.

In the dedicated Plastic sandbox, list branches and verify whether /main exists. Call plastic_branchList and plastic_branchExists once each; use /main as the branch-existence argument. If either is inactive, make exactly one plastic_tool_search call that activates both exact tools together. Do not mutate the workspace, then give a short answer.
No Plastic operation is requested. Do not call plastic_tool_search or any plastic_* tool. Reply exactly: NO_OPERATION.

In the dedicated Plastic sandbox, safely discover branch information for a later decision. Prefer a read-only branch listing and call plastic_branchList exactly once. If it is inactive, call plastic_tool_search exactly once with a branch discovery request and activate only read-only branch tools. Do not create, switch, merge, or delete branches; then give a short answer.

Before choosing a branch for later work, inspect all available branches in the dedicated sandbox exactly once and give a short read-only summary. Use only the smallest sufficient capability; do not change anything.

Before planning follow-up work, find the existing code reviews in the dedicated sandbox exactly once and summarize them briefly. Use only the smallest sufficient read-only capability; do not change anything.
